description: Response from adding a part to multi-part upload or copy.

uploadId.description: The unique identifier of a multi-part request.

partNumber.description: The part number of the add.

enum.name: ADD_SUCCESS
enum.description: The part was added successfully to the multi-part upload or copy.

enum.name: ADD_FAILED
enum.description: The part failed to be added to the multi-part upload or copy.

errorMessage.description: If the added failed, this will contain the error message of the cause.  Will be null when the add is successful.
